## InitTemplateConstructorParameters interface

Configuration parameters for constructing an `xpm init` template.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface InitTemplateConstructorParameters 
```

## Remarks

This interface defines the required configuration for creating an instance of [InitTemplateBase](./xpm-lib.inittemplatebase.md) or its derived classes. All properties are mandatory except for the optional `process` parameter, parameter, which defaults to the global Node.js `process` object when not specified.

The parameters provide the template with access to the <b>xpm</b> context, file system paths, property definitions, and the process environment necessary for template operations.
